author: Sheri Hadley
text: They were very knowledgeable and got our plumbing fixed in a very timely manner! Would definitely recommend again.

author: Mustard N Biscuits
text: Fast and knowledgeable! Fair priced and now have a new and reliable plumbing service. Thank you Angel Duck!

author: Matt Fischer
text: Dan came out quickly on a Saturday, cleaned our plugged drain. Awesome work, very nice, will continue to use Angel Duck Plumbing...big thank you!!!

author: Claudia Bateman
text:
I have used Dan at Angel Duck Plumbing for three different
jobs around my home in the last three years. They were prompt, reasonable, and very friendly. Did the work to my satisfaction. Would certainly recommend them. Claudia Bateman

author: Nicole Sanchez
text: I highly recommend using Angel Duck Plumbing for any plumbing/gas issues. We were able to get on schedule quickly. Dan the owner and plumber was very knowledgeable, he let us know step-by-step what his plan was for our issue and completed the job perfectly.
